summary: Iteration 4 backend tests — 15/15 passed in 4.92s. Validated the new PATCH /api/jee/topic/{topic_id}/meta endpoint (status=2 flips completed=true, notes/revisions persist and round-trip through GET /api/jee/syllabus; status=3 awards +30 XP bonus confirmed by before/after /api/profile comparison; empty payload is a safe no-op). Confirmed /api/jee/syllabus response now includes 'mastered' count (int, >=1 after status=3). Validated Task model new fields year/status/link on POST /api/tasks (persisted, echoed in GET list, and defaults: year=None, status='active', link=''). Regression spot-checks green on /profile, /tasks CRUD+toggle, /achievements, /public-profile, /tasks/boss, /dashboard/summary, /ai/chat.

minor.issue: No validation on status range — accepts any int (e.g., status=99 would still flip completed=true because it is >=2). Consider Literal[0,1,2,3] or Pydantic ge/le constraints.

XP is awarded every time status=3 is set, so repeatedly PATCHing status=3 on the same topic stacks +30 XP each call (no idempotency check against prior status). The inline comment 'find old status … simplified' acknowledges this TODO.
No topic_id validation against JEE_SYLLABUS — PATCH on an unknown topic_id still upserts a progress doc and returns 200.
Task.status is a free-form str; docstring says 'active|completed|archived' but no Literal enforced, so clients can set status='foobar'.

action_items: (Optional) Constrain JeeStatusUpdate.status to Literal[0,1,2,3] or int ge=0 le=3.
(Optional) Make the +30 XP mastered bonus idempotent by reading the previous status and awarding only on a transition into 3.
(Optional) Validate topic_id against flat_topics() in update_jee_meta; return 404 on unknown.
critical_code_review_comments: update_jee_meta correctly auto-flips completed=true when status>=2 and writes updated_at/user_id/topic_id on upsert — matches the syllabus aggregation contract.
jee_syllabus now returns 'mastered' count alongside 'done' and 'total'; structure is backwards compatible.
Task/TaskCreate include year/status/link with sensible defaults; extra='ignore' on Task means legacy docs without these fields still deserialize cleanly on GET /api/tasks.
toggle_task still uses task.xp * multiplier so is_boss 2x still applies for tasks with status='completed' created from the new fields; no regression there.
The 'pass  # simplified - award mastered bonus' block is dead code before the actual award_xp call — safe to remove for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 tasks (TEST_iter4 portfolio site, TEST_iter4 simple) + 1 regression task — all deleted via DELETE /api/tasks/{id} in fixture teardown and confirmed via mongo cleanup (0 lingering). Created 2 TEST_iter4_regress chat_messages which were deleted directly via mongo. JEE progress docs for physics-11-kinematics and physics-11-laws-of-motion were reset to status=0/notes=''/revisions=0 at the end of the JEE test class; they remain in jee_progress but in a clean state. The +30 XP bonus from the status=3 test was intentionally not rolled back and remains on the player_one profile (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 1 (test_backend_api.py), Iter 2 (test_achievements_public.py), Iter 3 (test_iter3_boss_ai_pwa.py), Iter 4 (test_iter4_jee_meta_task_fields.py) all pass. JEE meta endpoint is idempotent only for non-status fields — setting status=3 multiple times stacks XP. Task.status is a free-form string. No DELETE /api/jee/topic/{id} exists to remove progress docs created by tests.
